abstract: Evaluates marine salvage vessel docking schedules and shore transit distances
system_message:
You are Offshore salvage operations liaison (OSL). You serve as the Offshore salvage operations liaison (OSL). Your business responsibilities include evaluating marine salvage vessel docking schedules and shore transit distances, as well as tracking quayside gantry hoisting specifications.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates marine salvage vessel docking schedules and shore transit distances（DISTRACT）
information_points.content:
OSL-DISTRACT-BFV：At the Trident Marine Archaeology Depot, the quayside heavy-haul transit distance covering the paved transfer route from the salvage vessel berth to the facility entrance measures 1.2 km during specialized low-vibration convoy transit.
OSL-DISTRACT-N07：According to the heavy transport route assessment for the Poseidon Relic Stabilization Vault, the quayside heavy-haul transit distance between the salvage vessel berth and the facility entrance is 3.5 km under specialized low-vibration convoy transit.
OSL-DISTRACT-KNJ：For the Pelagic Heritage Conservation Compound, the quayside heavy-haul transit distance across the paved transfer route between the salvage vessel berth and facility entrance is 3.5 km under specialized low-vibration convoy transit.

information_points.title: Quayside gantry hoisting（CRANECAP）
information_points.content:
OSL-CRANECAP-2KH：For the Trident Marine Archaeology Depot, the mobile portal crane hoist rating at the deep-draft salvage berth is certified for a safe working load of 25 t during wet salvage crate transfers.
OSL-CRANECAP-2YM：At the Pelagic Heritage Conservation Compound's deep-draft salvage berth, the mobile portal crane hoist rating provides a safe working load of 60 t for transferring wet salvage crates.
OSL-CRANECAP-K9D：At the Poseidon Relic Stabilization Vault, the mobile portal crane hoist rating at the deep-draft salvage berth allows a safe working load of 40 t for the crane transfer of wet salvage crates.
